paper.identity: Own paper-setting reconstruction; not verified original-author code or verified numerical reproduction
paper.code_search: Bounded title/ProLSFEO/ProLSFEO-LDL web and GitHub repository searches found no verified author implementation; not a claim that none exists

scope: Exactly Music, Painting and SJAFFE, E11 fold0, Full only. Three already-consulted development cases; single declared seed each. Not full paper benchmark, fresh confirmation, subject-group validation or a substitute for E16 tuned baseline analysis. No changes to earlier primary endpoints.

paper_settings.chromosome: n prototype bits followed by q*d label-specific feature bits
paper_settings.HUX: Exchange floor(number of different bits/2) randomly selected differing positions; no mutation
paper_settings.fitness: Mean KL over predictions pooled from ten-fold inner validation, label-specific AA-kNN components normalized to simplex
paper_settings.restart: At stagnation counter1 preserve best old parent and replace99 with new uniform genomes; reset counter10. Counter decreases on unchanged population and is not otherwise reset, following paper Algorithm1.

explicit_implementation_assumptions.parent_pairing: Randomly permute100 parents, pair adjacent, emit two HUX offspring per pair. No extra distance-based mating threshold absent from Algorithm1.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.ties: Stable distance order by original outer-fit order; genome lexical packed-bit order for equal fitness; duplicates allowed. Population equality means multiset of genomes, not only best fitness.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.folds: Ten folds of exact-full-feature duplicate groups, randomly permuted and assigned greedily to currently smallest fold (lowest-fold tie), seed=optimization seed+1. No subject IDs available.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.validation_exclusion: For each inner fold, retained prototype pool is T intersect inner-training rows; held fold never supplies a prototype or training label.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.scaling: Min/max fitted on each inner training fold, constant coordinates zero, no query clipping. Final deployable scaling fitted on whole outer fit set.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.empty_genome: No retained prototype, no retained prototype in any inner fold, or any label with zero selected features yields infinite unavailable fitness; no genome repair. k=min(4, retained inner-prototype count).
explicit_implementation_assumptions.zero_mass: Zero-total component prediction invalid in inner fitness. At final inference only, if encountered, fallback to outer-fit mean; retained in state. KL uses predicted floor1e-12 for scoring only; predictions are not smoothed by that floor.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.cache: Identical genomes cache fitness; counts unique evaluated genomes.
explicit_implementation_assumptions.time_limit: 3600 wall seconds per case, checked at each generation. If not500 generations, mark time_limit_incomplete. Incomplete results remain diagnostics, never presented as complete paper-setting evidence. No reduced-generation restart or hidden replacement.

comparisons: Native reconstructed predictions primary; half-prior adaptation separately labeled secondary, not original method. Stable-order AA4 on full outer-fit set and its half-prior counterpart. Existing frozen GG50/UU50 anchors and E16 selected policies can be compared descriptively on same three cases after both prediction freezes, with availability counts. No three-case superiority claim.
planned_outputs: All three prediction records freeze before outer labels are scored. Aggregate seven metrics, selected prototype count/label feature counts/union features/numeric arrays, generations, runtime, failures and caveats. Private arrays include genome, partitions, standalone state and predictions; public code and aggregates only.
storage_boundary: Arrays for standalone inference (union retained features, retained original prototypes/labels, per-label masks, preprocessing and fallback prior). Scalar metadata and software/workspace excluded. Selection cost must be disclosed; this method does not share fixed prototype count with GG50.
technical_checks: Synthetic scalar-distance reference, inner-held-label replacement, exact HUX count, deterministic short synthetic search, duplicate-group isolation, exported-state prediction. Reduced synthetic sizes are code checks only.
